title: Local prediction smoke workflow
description: Implement and verify one realistic local control-plane worker path using generic demo data: scorecard -> score -> champion score version -> item -> prediction -> score result writeback -> dashboard/CLI readback. No production or client-specific data.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Prediction smoke workflow milestone is now completed and superseded by strict proof artifacts (CLI, prediction, browser, and clean proof harness). Follow-on work is tracked under the Local feedback evaluation MVP epic.
